entry.description: The `SmtpAppender` of `log4net.Ext.Mail` sends the body quoted-printable, or base64 for a UTF-16 or UTF-32 `BodyEncoding`. A carriage return from logged content used to reach the relay bare, and a relay that enforces RFC 5321 refused the whole batch. A body with non-ASCII text can be up to three times larger on the wire than as 8bit (fixed by @FreeAndNil)
